title: Unit 31 Consolidation: Historical Trauma and Memory
goal: I can use the words of historical trauma, responsibility and working through the past.
I can use stance adverbials, participles before a noun, contrast, purpose and scalar adverbs.
I can explain Bibó István's term *politikai hisztéria* and give neutral examples.
